card.name: Interacting drug class or name endings
card.fires_on: The last part of a drug or drug-class name in interaction statements, such as cyclosporine, contraceptives, antidiabetic agents, or neuraxial anesthesia. It fires just before the sentence says what the other drug may change.

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: Partway through or at the end of a drug name that is the object of an interaction.
modes.example: concomitant use of NSAIDs with cyclosp<<or>>ine, particularly in the setting of dehydration

modes.label: Class word ending a drug group
modes.description: The noun that completes a drug class, such as medications, agent, or anesthesia.
modes.example: A reduction in insulin or oral hypoglycemic<< medications>> in patients with diabetes mellitus may be
